body.x: Miro (CEO Oh Yong-ju, Seo dong-jin, Kim Min-seok) participated in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 as the official partner in CES startup zone Eureka Park MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT.

Miro is an environmental home appliance company founded in 2014, and it introduced its humidifier and air purifier. In CES 2020, it introduced the humidifier NR08. Unlike regular humidifiers, all of the NR08 humidifier can be washed. The humidifier can be washed like how you would clean the coffee mugs, and for the first time in Korea, its humidifying engine can be cleaned. Unlike the humidifiers that only the water container can be cleaned, users can be more assured of the cleanliness.

The MP18H13G humidifier is equipped with a feature that automatically detects indoor pollution and cleans the air automatically. The 18,000 air intakes boast the highest efficiency for the area and set a new standard for air purifiers.

AVING NEWS, the media that has made the most promotion of Korean companies, has set up MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT (Sands Expo, Level 1, Hall G #52843) in CES 2020 Startup Zone EUREKA PARK as the project to help Korean startups to enter the global market, and will introduce the major Korean startups to the world. By using the strengths of CES, AVING NEWS plans to inform investors, buyers and media Korea’s promising startups through various programs such as strategic consulting, PR marketing, and networking parties. MIK Zone was hosted by Next Generation Convergence Contents Industry Association, AVING NEWS, and MD Insight, and organized by Bluefoot. It was participated by Changwon Industry Promotion Agency, Incheon Techno Park Startup Support Center, Gwangju University Startup Support Group, and Sungshin Women's University Startup Support Group.
